steps.label: STEP 01
steps.title: Apply & Get Verified
steps.description: Complete a short online application. Our partnerships team reviews your profile within 5 business days and verifies your credentials, certifications, and market fit.

steps.label: STEP 02
steps.title: Onboarding & Training
steps.description: Access a structured onboarding journey — live kickoff sessions, product deep-dives, sales playbooks, and a dedicated certification pathway to get you sales-ready fast.

steps.label: STEP 03
steps.title: Start Selling & Co-Marketing
steps.description: Begin co-selling with our account executives, register your first deals, and activate joint marketing campaigns backed by MDF funding and Whiteguard brand equity.

steps.label: STEP 04
steps.title: Scale & Earn More
steps.description: Unlock higher revenue tiers, earn quarterly rebates, and gain priority access to new product releases. The more you sell, the more the program invests back in you.
